queriesAndRequests: See city-220-belfast.json freshResearch. English and Irish-language discovery were performed separately. Official LPS registry documentation, nidirect access guidance, Spatial NI viewer entry page, and the current public ArcGIS Hub HTML/configuration were inspected anonymously.
requestOutcomes: LPS Land Registry map page: HTTP 200; registry map and digital registered-holding documentation returned, no public parcel API.
nidirect Land Registry search guidance: HTTP 200; explicitly states online searching is not currently available; no authenticated or record-specific lookup attempted.
Spatial NI page: HTTP 200; linked the public OSNI Spatial NI viewer.
OSNI Spatial NI ArcGIS Hub: HTTP 200; current public HTML/configuration inspected; no verified anonymous parcel service, schema, CRS, or safe ID+geometry response identified.
No exact-point parcel query was attempted after no anonymous parcel endpoint was identified; no map-extent miss, timeout, login wall, or UI failure is treated as citywide absence.
